title: Jobs tray instead of a one-slot pill with a made-up percentage
gap: Header.tsx:61-66 renders one ws.state.gen slot as a percentage. The number comes from fixed phase constants 4/10/50/100 (lib/workspace/rig.ts:151-158, use-composer.ts:108-113), not from the job. Clicking the pill opens Atomik › Runs (Header.tsx:63), which lists pipeline runs and not this job. Every new job overwrites the slot. Jobs started from Business (lib/shell/use-connected-job.ts), Viral (lib/shell/use-viral.ts), Storyboards, Environment and the Takes re-edit never appear in the header at all.
target: Header pill reads '3 rendering · 1 held' and opens a JobsTray popover (phone: bottom sheet). Its rows come from GET /api/jobs?projectId&status=queued|running|held (extend the existing route to accept a comma list) plus the existing GET job lists on /api/higgsfield/consumer/generation, the genjutsu route and the video route. Each row shows the thumbnail or name, a real stage (Queued / Held · needs N cr / Rendering / Complete / Failed · not billed + reason), time since createdAt, the approved price, and one action: Open in Takes, Release (held), or Recreate (failed). Replace the single state.gen slot with a jobs map keyed by id. Show a percentage ring only when an engine reports real progress; otherwise use an indeterminate stage bar.
respects_rules: Only reads existing job routes. Release goes through the existing POST /api/jobs/:id/release. Prices shown are the ones already approved.
